newsitem.title: BULGARIA: No bids approved at Bulgaria's 3-yr T-note auction.
newsitem.headline: No bids approved at Bulgaria's 3-yr T-note auction.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry offer of 500 million levs of three-year floater coupon T-notes was not sold at Friday's auction after all bids were rejected by the ministry, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
Banks placed bids for 256 million levs worth of paper at an average price of 43.49 percent of par but the ministry approved none, the BNB said.
The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Its semi-annual coupon was set equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity.
The CIR is now set at 15 percent monthly or 180 percent annually.
Three weeks ago the ministry also rejected all bids for 500 million levs of two-year T-notes because of the low price of the bids, which was 45 percent of par.
